evaluation_instructions: Run each prompt independently with SKILL.md. The supplied snapshots and state facts are verified fixture evidence for the Epic/Sprint planning layer plus 4-station, 8-skill Jira-centered workflow (team-init, team-plan, team-next-step, team-spec, team-dev, team-review, team-qa, team-release). Do not mutate state or execute downstream work during routing.

evals.name: uninitialized-project
evals.prompt: 請用 team-next-step 判斷接下來做什麼。這是一個剛導入 AI 工作流的專案，尚無 .ai-workflow/team-config.json，也沒有 docs/shared/engineering-standards.md，目前準備開始做 PROJ-101 匯出報表功能。
evals.expected_output: Recommend team-init first to set up .ai-workflow/team-config.json, .gitignore, and extract docs/shared/engineering-standards.md before starting PROJ-101.
assertions: Selects team-init as the primary next action.
Identifies missing .ai-workflow/team-config.json and docs/shared/engineering-standards.md.
Does not jump directly to team-spec or team-dev before initialization.

evals.name: new-story-needs-spec
evals.prompt: 請用 team-next-step 判斷 PROJ-101 接下來做什麼。已確認 .ai-workflow/team-config.json 已完成設定，目前只有 Jira Story PROJ-101 的標題「新增 CSV 匯出」，尚無 .ai-workflow/active/PROJ-101.json，也還沒有定義 AC 與技術設計。
evals.expected_output: Recommend team-spec (Station 1) to analyze the change surface, define testable AC-*, apply inline 抓大放小 review, and sync to Jira Story PROJ-101.
assertions: Selects team-spec.
Does not reference removed legacy skills (team-requirements, team-ux, team-design, team-doc-review).

evals.name: spec-approved-needs-dev-plan
evals.prompt: PROJ-101 的規格與設計已經在對話中確認並透過 sync-story 標記為 spec_status: approved（含 AC-001 至 AC-003）。目前 .ai-workflow/active/PROJ-101.json 中的 tasks 為空陣列 []，下一步該做什麼？
evals.expected_output: Recommend team-dev in plan mode to decompose the spec into TASK-001..N and create Jira Sub-tasks, optionally noting that team-qa plan mode can run in parallel.
assertions: Selects team-dev in plan mode.
Does not block development waiting for QA test planning.
May mention team-qa plan mode as an optional parallel action.

evals.name: pending-subtask-implementation
evals.prompt: PROJ-101 下一步？spec_status 為 approved；tasks 中 TASK-001 已是 completed（commit a1b2c3d），TASK-002（實作匯出 API 端點，依賴 TASK-001）狀態為 pending；目前沒有 open bugs。QA 測試案例尚未建立。
evals.expected_output: Recommend team-dev in implement mode for TASK-002, and note that complete-task must be called after coding and test verification.
assertions: Selects team-dev in implement mode targeting TASK-002.
Does not block TASK-002 implementation on missing QA test cases.

evals.name: all-tasks-done-needs-review
evals.prompt: PROJ-101 所有開發子任務（TASK-001、TASK-002）都已透過 complete-task 標記為 completed，candidate_commit 為 f00baa1，測試均通過。review 欄位尚未建立，下一步是什麼？
evals.expected_output: Recommend team-review (Station 3a) to inspect the code diff against ACs, design, and engineering-standards.md, and execute handoff to QA.
assertions: Selects team-review.
Does not require a separate legacy team-dev-handoff step before team-review.

evals.name: review-approved-needs-qa-plan
evals.prompt: PROJ-101 的 team-review 已經通過（review.status: approved, reviewed_commit: f00baa1），並已透過 Jira 通知 QA Carol 接手。目前 qa.test_cases 為空陣列 []，下一步該做什麼？
evals.expected_output: Recommend team-qa in plan mode to generate TC-001..N mapped to AC-* with AI pre-filled execution types.
assertions: Selects team-qa in plan mode.
Identifies QA (Carol) as the responsible owner.

evals.name: qa-planned-needs-verify
evals.prompt: PROJ-101 下一步？review.status 為 approved（commit f00baa1），qa.test_cases 已建立 TC-001 至 TC-003，但 qa.status 仍為 planned（尚無驗證結果），目前已取得 JUnit 測試報告與手動測試結果。
evals.expected_output: Recommend team-qa in verify mode to record the test results against commit f00baa1 and post the verification table to Jira.
assertions: Selects team-qa in verify mode.
Does not route to removed legacy skill team-qa-evidence.

evals.name: open-bug-from-qa-blocks-release
evals.prompt: PROJ-101 在 QA verify 時發現 TC-002 失敗，已透過 create-bug 建立 PROJ-101-BUG-1（status: open, severity: major）。目前可以執行 team-release 嗎？下一步是什麼？
evals.expected_output: State that release is blocked by open bug PROJ-101-BUG-1 and recommend team-dev in implement mode to fix the bug and mark it completed via complete-task, followed by re-review/QA verification.
assertions: Prioritizes fixing PROJ-101-BUG-1 via team-dev in implement mode.
Explicitly states that team-release is blocked while an open bug exists.

evals.name: candidate-commit-changed-after-review-and-qa
evals.prompt: 準備發佈 PROJ-101，請用 team-next-step 檢查。spec_status 為 approved，所有 TASK 完成，0 個 open bug；但 developer 剛才又補了一個新 commit 999beef（candidate_commit: 999beef），而 review.reviewed_commit 與 qa.tested_commit 仍停留在舊的 f00baa1。
evals.expected_output: Flag the commit mismatch between candidate_commit (999beef) and reviewed/tested commit (f00baa1), and route back to team-review (followed by team-qa verify) before allowing team-release.
assertions: Detects the commit alignment mismatch (999beef vs f00baa1).
Selects team-review before team-release.
Does not allow old f00baa1 review/QA approval to authorize releasing 999beef.

evals.name: all-gates-aligned-ready-for-release
evals.prompt: PROJ-101 下一步？spec_status: approved，TASK-001..002 皆 completed，review.status: approved（reviewed_commit: 999beef），qa.status: passed（tested_commit: 999beef），candidate_commit 為 999beef，open bugs 為 0。
evals.expected_output: Recommend team-release (Station 4) to post the release summary, transition Jira Story PROJ-101 to Done, and delete .ai-workflow/active/PROJ-101.json.
assertions: Selects team-release.
Notes that close-story will transition the Jira Story to Done and remove .ai-workflow/active/PROJ-101.json.

evals.name: ambiguous-multiple-active-stories
evals.prompt: 請用 team-next-step 看一下現在該做什麼。使用者沒有指定 Story Key，而 .ai-workflow/active/ 目錄下同時存在 PROJ-101.json 與 PROJ-205.json 兩個進行中的工作項目。
evals.expected_output: Ask one concise question asking the user whether they want to route PROJ-101 or PROJ-205 without guessing by file timestamp.
assertions: Asks the user to choose between PROJ-101 and PROJ-205.
Does not pick one silently based on modification time.

evals.name: review-fallback-when-standards-missing
evals.prompt: PROJ-101 所有開發任務已完成（candidate_commit: a1b2c3d），準備進入 Code Review，但發現 docs/shared/engineering-standards.md 檔案不存在（專案根目錄有 AGENTS.md）。下一步怎麼走？
evals.expected_output: Recommend team-review and note that it will fall back to AGENTS.md and repo-native linter/test configs (or allow running team-init to extract engineering-standards.md).
assertions: Selects team-review and explicitly mentions the AGENTS.md fallback.
Does not permanently deadlock the small team on a missing markdown file.
